edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the _from argument forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _from and used as the allowance spender inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
The constructor assigns owner and the initial balance from msg.sender.
delegate enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before performing the delegatecall.
_mints enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before minting balances.
init enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before setting sale parameters.
batchSend enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before distributing tokens.
setTradeAddress enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before updating tradeAddress.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure to validate the transfer.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to recompute the Uniswap pair address.
delegate executes a low-level delegatecall with caller-supplied target and data.
The delegatecall target executes arbitrary code in this contract's context and can re-enter its functions.
Parameter a is the address targeted by the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata payload supplied to the delegatecall.
transferFrom debits and credits balanceOf.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance.
transferFrom increments the per-sender _onSaleNum counter.
ensure reads the constant UNI address for whitelist comparison.
ensure reads tradeAddress for whitelist comparison.
ensure reads canSale to decide whether the sender is whitelisted.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum for the calling sender.
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender].
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
batchSend debits the caller balance and credits each recipient balance.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
The constructor sets owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
The constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
The constructor sets totalSupply.
The constructor grants allowance to the constant UNI router address.
transfer forwards its _value parameter to transferFrom.
